name: Display Preferences
job: Give every reader the theme switch and the reading options (easy-read font, larger text, roomy spacing) side by side in the header, remembered on their device.

anatomy.role: Pill button: icon, the label `Dark mode`, a track; `aria-pressed` says if dark is on; 48px tall
48px circle beside it, `aria-expanded`, opens the panel below itself
Non-modal dialog placed under the Aa button, right edges aligned; groups of pressed buttons
`data-font=easy` swaps `--ds-font-sans` and `--ds-font-display`; `data-size` l/xl sets the root font to 112.5%/125%; `data-space=roomy` adds letter, word and line spacing
At 520px and below the switch's text label is visually hidden; the icon and track stay

states.name: Header row
states.note: Switch and Aa side by side at the right of the top row.

states.name: Panel open
states.note: Font, Text size, Spacing; the current choice is pressed. Escape or Close returns focus to Aa.

use_when: Any client page whose readers include people who rely on a dyslexia-friendly font, larger text or wider spacing.
Every other block on the page must use rem or em and the kit font tokens, so these settings reach it.
Run the reading-options check on every page change: largest size, roomy spacing and easy-read font, at 375 and 1280.
avoid_when: Do not float the Aa button at the bottom of the page; it lives in the header next to the theme switch.
Do not use it on a video frame or fixed render. Pages with only a theme need just 39 Theme toggle.

data.note: localStorage key for the saved settings object, such as `myAllyRead`; read in a pre-paint head script, every access in try/catch.
Defaults: font std/easy, size std/l/xl, space std/roomy.

access: The theme switch is a `<button>` named `Dark mode` with `aria-pressed`; the label stays in the accessible name on phones when it is visually hidden.
The Aa button has `aria-label=Reading options`, `aria-expanded` and `aria-controls`; the panel is `role=dialog` with `aria-modal=false`, labelled by its title.
Opening moves focus to the pressed option; Escape or Close closes and returns focus to Aa.
Options are groups of `aria-pressed` buttons, each 44px tall, with a visible label per group.

used_by.name: Approved My Ally Step 1 template (public/myally-hub.html, PR 2094)
Sibling of 39 Theme toggle (39 unchanged for its consumers)

gates: `kit_specimen.py --check` (in scripts): this page matches its spec.
`kit_primitive_sync.py --check` (in scripts): every page that marks this block carries it unchanged.
Reading-options check: 375 and 1280, light and dark, largest text size, roomy spacing and the easy-read font.
